title: Don't carry cash in GTA 6
yt_title: Stop carrying cash in GTA 6 💸 (BuckMe, dye packs, fast money)
description:
GTA 6 money tips: pocket cash is lost if you get Wasted or Busted, so deposit it at ATMs into your BuckMe account (GamesRadar, GameSpot, PC Gamer). Bank cash carries dye packs: get a Dye Pack Jammer before you hit a bank (GameSpot, VGC). Fastest money per four big guides: robberies (stores first, then banks) and selling stolen cars and goods through fences. Pocket cash is reportedly capped at $20,000 (GamesRadar only, unconfirmed). Where do you keep your cash?

Sources: https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-money-buckme-bank-account-manage/ https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-safe-codes-and-robberies-guide/ https://www.gamespot.com/articles/best-ways-to-make-money-fast-in-gta-6/
